title: UEREMCP Template / Pattern Library Item
description: A reusable construction pattern, not a copied asset (master prompt §5.3). Domain-general: Niagara, material, Blueprint, gameplay, animation, replication, UI, AI patterns all use this shape. Owned by WS-01; substrate decision pending ADR-0008 / RB-10 (whether these are backed by Epic's UAgentSkill, which already supports agent-authored CreateSkill/UpdateSkill).

purpose.description: What problem this pattern solves, in the project's language.

inherits_from.description: template_id of a parent pattern. Composition over duplication.

inputs.description: JSON Schema (or a subset) describing the parameters this template accepts. This is what makes a template callable rather than merely descriptive.

outputs.description: What instantiating produces: asset roles and their classes.

required_components.description: Structural parts that must exist, e.g. Niagara emitters or Blueprint functions.

supported_modifiers.description: Search/display index of named variations. A name is executable only when an equal key exists in modifier_definitions; declaration-only names must fail closed.

modifier_definitions.description: Executable deltas for names accepted in instantiate_template.specification.modifiers. Accepted from WS-05 1ef125d / docs/proposals/ws-01-template-validation-schema.md. Application is deterministic; unknown names fail before mutation.

bucket.description: Must match the request modifiers bucket that contains this name.

replace_operations.description: Replace one complete operation; the object key must equal the replacement operation id.

merge_specifications.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch applied only to the named operation's specification. Cannot alter id, action, dependencies, target, mode, or transaction policy.

append_operations.description: Append complete schema-valid operations. IDs must remain globally unique in the materialized plan.

validation_operations.description: Appended after construction effects from this modifier.

generate_if_missing.description: Whether the service should procedurally generate absent dependencies rather than failing (master prompt §6).

construction_plan.description: The ordered, machine-executable steps that build this pattern — the field that makes this a template rather than documentation. Each step is a batch-plan operation.

validation_rules.description: Checks that must pass for an instance to be considered correct. A rule is executable only when it carries a semantic operation; check-only rules are legacy descriptive metadata and force partially_completed.

check.description: Optional descriptive legacy metadata. Not evaluated by the executor.

operation.description: Normal plan operation materialized after construction steps. Evidence ID template.<template_id>.<rule_id> must appear in validation.checks_performed for the rule to count as performed.

typical_ranges.description: Sane value ranges per parameter, so an agent picks plausible numbers without a round trip.

known_failure_cases.description: What has actually gone wrong with this pattern and how it was resolved. This is the field that makes the library compound in value — record failures, not just successes (master prompt §10).

search_terms.description: Similarity-matching aids, so 'I need a fiery projectile' finds this without exact naming.
